## Scope / 范围

Describe the release or distribution task.

## Target Platforms / 目标平台

- Linux x86_64
- Linux arm64
- rpm
- tar.gz
- zip

## Required Checks / 必要检查

- workspace tests
- package smoke
- installed-layout validation
- checksum generation

Record final artifact names, versions, and any manual follow-up.
